reviewMethod: Every listed frame was opened and inspected individually and sequentially at its native 1280x960 capture size. Contact sheets, thumbnails, and image metrics were not substituted for visual review.

story.finding: All captures are native real-time level renders rather than FMV/title footage. They preserve the PS1 environments and exercise all 34 story-loaded Dreamcast actor overrides. Scene validity and resource coverage are not treated as automatic visual acceptance for user-held actors. L8A6 is a scripted real-time sequence and its second frame is mostly camera-occluded.

viewer.finding: All 26 selectable models were inspected. The current Black Cat, neutral-grey Jameson, and articulated Scorpion captures are technically coherent but remain held for user acceptance. MYSTVIEW intentionally has no fishbowl mesh: both original Dreamcast MYSTVIEW.PSX and MYSTERIO.PSX decode without one, so the bowl is a separate retail effect rather than lost converted geometry.

hostagef.finding: Both captures were inspected; the HOSTAGEF alias is complete and coherent in the Parker viewer slot.

symbiote.finding: All 19 sequential roster captures were inspected. The final target capture confirms that the otherwise unrouted SYMBIOTE alias matches the authored translucent goo form used by the compatible SYMBI_02 slot.

jamesonScorpion.finding: Scorpion's tail remains attached, continuously articulated, blue/green textured, and hook-aligned through all 11 frames. Jameson's body is not visible in this sequence, so these frames prove his resource/runtime presence but not his appearance; his current neutral-grey visual evidence is the Character Viewer frame_05850.png. Both actors remain held for user acceptance.
